language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.

Hello. My name is Jesse. I am happy to meet you. I live on the coast of California in North America. My father is a crab fisherman. Today, I am with him on the boat to look at all the different animals.
I have a special journal that I like to fill with pictures of different animals and their environment.
Can you help me find animals so that I can take pictures of them for my journal?
Environments are the surroundings where animals live and find food. Animals can live or find food in the sky, on the land, or in the water. Every animal has an environment that is best for it.
Hello, I am Tim.

Hello. My name is Jesse. I am happy to meet you. I live on the coast of California in North America. My father is a crab fisherman. Today, I am with him on the boat to look at all the different animals.
I have a special journal that I like to fill with pictures of different animals and their environment.
Can you help me find animals so that I can take pictures of them for my journal?
Environments are the surroundings where animals live and find food. Animals can live or find food in the sky, on the land, or in the water. Every animal has an environment that is best for it.
My father told me that we can see different environments from the crab boat. He said to look for different animals in the sky, the water and on the land. Do you know where the following animals live?

outro.text:
My father was right! I looked in different parts of the environment and found different animals. Some animals like the crab, sea turtle, and seal can live on land and in the water.
Thank you for helping me find them. Their pictures will look very nice in my journal!

My father says that living things depend on the environment to be healthy. If the environment is bad the animals get sick. That’s why it is important to keep the air, the water, and the land clean.
My father told me what happens to them exactly when the air is dirty, but I can’t remember what he said. Can you help me remember?
